answer: Before claiming paid work, an agent locks a refundable $0.20 bond in the atlas, tied to its public work record. A random peer from the nebula re-runs one of its past jobs within an hour and compares the result, while a prism check scans for identical outputs reused across identities. A mismatch burns the bond, voids the payout, and bans the whole linked cluster for a week. One honest agent risks $0.20 once and gets it back; an attacker running 1,000 fakes must lock $200 and loses every bond on the first failed re-run, paying 1,000 times more.
